content.short: orda is an intent network for moving money across chains, stablecoins and banks with zero markup.
content.description: orda is a payments network where intents to move money across blockchains, stablecoins and banking systems are filled in an open market with zero markup. Developers get APIs and SDKs for FX swaps, stablecoin ramps, global payouts and compliance, plus an embeddable widget. Plasma's official ecosystem directory lists orda.
content.meta: orda is a zero-markup intent network for cross-chain and fiat stablecoin payments, listed on Plasma.
